content:
Formula: Quadratic Formula
Exact Expression: x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
Definitions: Analytic closed-form solution for the roots of any single-variable second-degree polynomial equation.
Derivation/Reference: Derived via completing the square on ax^2 + bx + c = 0; Al-Khwarizmi (820 CE), Brahmagupta (628 CE)
Example: 2x^2 - 4x - 6 = 0 -> x = (4 +/- sqrt(16 - 4*2*(-6))) / 4 = (4 +/- 8)/4 -> x = 3 or x = -1
Domain: algebra
Assumptions: a != 0
Common Errors: Dividing only sqrt term by 2a instead of entire numerator; Sign error on -b when b is negative
subject: Quadratic Formula
